say.text: On the road to Mosul, at night. The household has stopped to rest the animals.
You have not spoken of the gate since we left Tikrit.
What is there to say? I shut you in a tower and wrote to Bihruz. Every word of it was my duty, and I have not slept well since.
It was your duty. I had that halberd out of his belt before I knew my own hand.
Bihruz had written back that he owed a debt to their father and could not deal harshly with either of them.
A kind sentence to be driven out on.
A kind sentence. We are alive, we have a lord who remembers a boat, and I have known worse exiles.
I would have you tell me once that I was wrong.
You were wrong to strike. You were not wrong about the woman. Keep the halberd, brother: a man should keep what he has paid for.
I will keep the letter. Now sleep. There is a child in the next tent who will want his uncle in the morning.
